title: The Moon was placed or towed into position

tellings.quote: Is it an illusion? Was it put there? Tim insinuated that it was it wasn't there by accident. That it was set there.

plain: The Moon may not be where it is by accident: it may have been put there on purpose, or set in place. That idea comes from a man named Timothy Taylor, and it is passed on by Chris Bledsoe, a man who says he attracts UFOs, who recalls that Taylor hinted the Moon "was set there" and asks whether it is "an illusion." If true, someone or something would have arranged the Moon itself.
